name: scheduling-project
description: RecipeMe: a user puts in their meal preferences (could be dietary restrictions, cuisine type, dietary goals, time commitment, taste profile, specific food preferences, budget, store preferences, expertise, appliances, themed-food, serving size, amount of pots used) - App will output recipe ideas based on preferences - Each recipe will come with a grocery list (with stores nearby = - - where you can purchase the items), prioritize one store - Save recipes that you really like to your favorites - Rate recipes to change their recommendation frequency. Can add recipes to cart
